claims.claim_vi: Python functional HOWTO: programming languages decompose problems as procedural (lists of instructions; C, Pascal and Unix shells), declarative (SQL), object-oriented (objects with internal state and methods; Smalltalk and Java are object-oriented, C++ and Python support but do not force it) or functional (functions that ideally only take inputs and produce outputs).
claims.verified_by: Read from a raw copy at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: Functional style discourages functions with side effects; functions with no side effects at all are called purely functional; map and filter are built-ins taking a function; testing is easier because each function is a potential unit test needing only synthesized input.
claims.section: Introduction; Ease of debugging and testing; map and filter
claims.verified_by: Read from a raw copy at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: Lisp, C++ and Python are multi-paradigm; Python programs in functional style usually keep local assignments inside while offering a functional-appearing interface.
